reader_summary.overview: This is Matt Reustle and today we are breaking down the home improvement giant, The Home Depot. In the US. Why has Home Depot been such a strong performer following a housing crash in the e-commerce revolution? I’m joined by Sean Stannard-Stockton of Ensemble Capital to break that down.

key_points.text: We cover how Home Depot transitioned their approach to business, from customer focus to capital allocation.
